_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); net revenue, credit cost, expense, nonperforming-asset and pre-tax margin signals with JPMorgan Chase's rule-T thresholds

pit_profile.why: 'JPMorgan Chase & Co. ... is a leading global financial services firm and one of the largest banking institutions in the United States' 'JPMorgan Chase’s businesses are materially affected by economic and market conditions' 'The financial services industry is highly competitive, and JPMorgan Chase’s inability to compete successfully may adversely affect its results of operations.' (FY2016 10-K); DURABLE, risk 2: the 10-K ties results to markets and the economy, a cycle and a competitive field, and does not call its own business cyclical (the word appears only in 'countercyclical capital buffer', a regulatory term: the LOW and SHW reading); among its competitors it lists 'e-commerce and other Internet-based companies, financial technology companies'; no theme in taxonomy_eras.json is live for a bank holding company on these dates (OFFSHORE is scoped to IT services, CLOUD to on-premise IT, ECOMMERCE to physical retail, STREAMING to linear TV, ENERGY_TRANSITION to oil, gas and coal), so the watch list is empty and these words stay here (the PEP obesity rule)

classification.quality_note: 'JPMorgan Chase & Co. ... is a leading global financial services firm and one of the largest banking institutions in the United States' 'JPMorgan Chase’s businesses are materially affected by economic and market conditions' 'The financial services industry is highly competitive, and JPMorgan Chase’s inability to compete successfully may adversely affect its results of operations.' (FY2016 10-K); DURABLE, risk 2: the 10-K ties results to markets and the economy, a cycle and a competitive field, and does not call its own business cyclical (the word appears only in 'countercyclical capital buffer', a regulatory term: the LOW and SHW reading); among its competitors it lists 'e-commerce and other Internet-based companies, financial technology companies'; no theme in taxonomy_eras.json is live for a bank holding company on these dates (OFFSHORE is scoped to IT services, CLOUD to on-premise IT, ECOMMERCE to physical retail, STREAMING to linear TV, ENERGY_TRANSITION to oil, gas and coal), so the watch list is empty and these words stay here (the PEP obesity rule). durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price rich; +68% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -0.07; conservative 2yr -27%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -80.1%/yr (worst year FY07-FY16, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +3.9%/yr (Q2 revenue YoY + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +3.9%/yr (FY07-FY16 CAGR, at least BASE); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +112.1%/yr (best 2-yr run FY07-FY16, at least BULL); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: JPM (retrospective, 2017-08-04) ✕ AVOID — Ratio B infx (97.9% downside to Bear $1.98 / -7.3% upside to Bull $86.84) | Adj composite 2.35 vs market 2.42: gap -0.07 [FAIRLY VALUED] | +68% above the EPP floor $55.71 (9x FY17E $6.19) | Conservative 2-yr case: -27.0% total (-13.5%/yr) | At 15.1x FY17E the 15% hurdle price $123.87 sits above the BULL case; revenue +4.5% YoY in Q2 2017, forward revenues +4.5% (Q2 2017 revenue growth (no Q3 2017 guide)); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
